issues.title: Missing GET /v1/segments/{segmentId}/contacts endpoint
issues.description: The Segments service does not implement a method to retrieve contacts belonging to a segment. The OpenAPI spec defines GET /v1/segments/{segmentId}/contacts for retrieving all contacts that match a segment's filter conditions.
issues.recommendation: Add a 'contacts' or 'getContacts' method to the Segments service that calls GET /v1/segments/{segmentId}/contacts with pagination support

issues.title: Missing GET /v1/topics/{topicId}/contacts endpoint
issues.description: The Topics service does not implement a method to retrieve contacts subscribed to a topic. The OpenAPI spec defines GET /v1/topics/{topicId}/contacts for retrieving all contacts subscribed to a specific topic.
issues.recommendation: Add a 'contacts' or 'getContacts' method to the Topics service that calls GET /v1/topics/{topicId}/contacts with pagination support

issues.title: Missing GET /v1/forms/{formId} endpoint
issues.description: The Forms service has a get() method but the OpenAPI specification includes GET /v1/forms/{formId}, PUT /v1/forms/{formId}, and DELETE /v1/forms/{formId} endpoints. Verify these endpoints are correctly mapped in the Payload class.
issues.recommendation: Verify that Forms::get, Forms::update, and Forms::delete correctly call the OpenAPI endpoints

issues.title: ApiKeys::create may not work with API key authentication
issues.description: The OpenAPI specification indicates that POST /v1/api-keys requires session authentication (user login), not API key authentication. The SDK implements this method but users calling it with an API key may receive authentication errors.
issues.recommendation: Document this limitation in the SDK or consider removing the create method from the ApiKeys service if it cannot be called with API key authentication
issues.openApiNote: Required Scope: This endpoint requires session authentication (not API key)

issues.title: Model classes lack typed properties
issues.description: The model classes (Contact, Topic, Segment, Form, ApiKey, ContactProperty) extend Resource but don't define typed properties. This makes it harder for IDE autocompletion and type checking. The OpenAPI spec defines specific response schemas with required fields.
issues.recommendation: Consider adding PHP 8+ typed properties or PHPDoc @property annotations based on OpenAPI response schemas for better type safety and IDE support

issues.title: Service methods lack parameter type documentation
issues.description: While the list() methods have PHPDoc for pagination options, the create() and update() methods accept generic array $parameters without documenting the expected fields from the OpenAPI schema.
issues.recommendation: Add PHPDoc @param annotations documenting the expected array keys based on OpenAPI request body schemas
issues.example: @param array{email: string, firstName?: string|null, lastName?: string|null, ...} $parameters
